outline: 本課程介紹作業研究中非線性模式之各項基本概念及應用，包含整數規劃、動態規劃、賽局原理、馬可夫鏈、等候原理、存貨模式、專案管理、模擬等。
schedule:
Week 1-3
The Transportation and Assignment Problem
Week 4-6
Network Optimization Models
Week 7-8
Dynamic programming
Week 9
Mid-term test
Week 10-12
Integer Programming
Week 13
Nonlinear Programming
Week 14
Decision Analysis
Week 15
Markov Chains
assessment:
期中考 30%
期末考 40%
平時成績 30%
